verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Aider letting a developer sign in with an existing subscription plan, such as a ChatGPT or Claude plan, to power the agent. The closest item is its copy/paste-to-web-chat mode (aider-docs-21). That is a manual workaround, not account sign-in, so it earns no credit. Model access is otherwise described only through LLM APIs and local models.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent
